Title: Concurrent duplicate SKU creation returned a raw database error (P2002) at service level
Steps to reproduce: 1. Two admins create the same SKU code at the same moment.
Expected result: One created; the other gets a typed CONFLICT (SKU already exists)
Actual result: Loser received raw P2002 at service level; HTTP layer already mapped it to 409 with a generic message

Title: Local processes on the PC are inside the trust boundary: a request from 127.0.0.1 can set X-Forwarded-For and choose its rate-limit bucket
Steps to reproduce: 1. From the PC, curl with X-Forwarded-For set to random values to login.
Expected result: Rate limit still applies per real client
Actual result: Local code can choose its bucket. Remote clients cannot: their peer is the proxy and the proxy appends the real address
